title: Contents Supplemental Calculation Sheet — HomeGuard Homeowners Policy
content:
The personal property (contents) supplemental on a HomeGuard Homeowners Policy claim is the settled basis of the contents less the contents money already issued, never below 0.00 and rounded to the cent once, on the final figure. Each quantity on the sheet is read from the records as follows.

**Section 1 — The claim and its contents figures**

1.1 The contents claim is taken from the newest first-notice entry on the policy, and the date of loss and cause of loss written on that entry apply to the contents.
1.2 The contents replacement-cost value and depreciation are those recorded on the claim's actual-cash-value initial payment entry for personal property.
1.3 The contents money already issued is every personal-property payment entry of the claim, recoverable-depreciation payments included.

**Section 2 — The deductible the contents absorb**

2.1 The occurrence deductible is one per occurrence: the all-other-perils deductible on the declarations or, for a wind or hail loss, the larger of the declarations' wind/hail percentage of Coverage A and the tier's wind/hail minimum (the package's wind/hail deductible minimum).
2.2 No deductible applies to the contents where the tier's deductible waiver threshold is above 0 and the replacement-cost values on the claim's denial entries and on its payment entries that replace no denial together reach it (are equal to it or greater).
2.3 For a freeze or sudden discharge loss, the deductible the customer already bore on a LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy freeze or sudden-discharge claim with the same date of loss counts toward the occurrence deductible as its same-event share, never more than the whole occurrence deductible. The share is the deductible carried on the payment entries of the customer's LandlordGuard freeze or sudden-discharge claims whose date of loss is the same as the HomeGuard claim's. For any other cause of loss the same-event share is 0.00.
2.4 When no waiver applies, the contents absorb what the occurrence deductible leaves after that same-event share and after the deductible carried on the claim's dwelling and other-structures payment entries, and never more than their replacement-cost value. Where nothing of the occurrence deductible is left, the contents absorb 0.00.

**Section 3 — Settled basis and supplemental**

3.1 The contents settled basis is their actual-cash-value figure: the replacement-cost value less the depreciation less the deductible the contents absorb.
3.2 The contents supplemental starts from the settled basis less the contents money already issued; it is never below 0.00 and is rounded to the cent once, on the final figure.

**Worksheet (hypothetical figures, for illustration only)**

*Case A — sudden discharge with a same-date LandlordGuard claim.* All-other-perils deductible 1000.00; package waiver threshold taken as 0, so no waiver; the customer's LandlordGuard sudden-discharge claim with the same date of loss carries 250.00 of deductible on its payment entries; the HomeGuard claim's dwelling payment entries carry 600.00 of deductible and its other-structures payment entries none; contents replacement-cost value 8400.00 and depreciation 2100.00 on the personal-property actual-cash-value initial payment entry; contents money already issued 6000.00.

| Line | Figure |
|---|---|
| Occurrence deductible | 1000.00 |
| Same-event share (250.00, not above 1000.00) | 250.00 |
| Deductible on dwelling and other-structures payment entries | 600.00 |
| Left for the contents: 1000.00 less 250.00 less 600.00 | 150.00 |
| Contents absorb the smaller of 150.00 and 8400.00 | 150.00 |
| Settled basis: 8400.00 less 2100.00 less 150.00 | 6150.00 |
| Less contents money already issued | 6000.00 |
| Contents supplemental | 150.00 |

*Case B — wind or hail.* Coverage A 400000; wind/hail percentage on the declarations 1, giving 4000.00, and a wind/hail minimum taken as 1000.00, so the occurrence deductible is the larger, 4000.00. No same-event share applies to a wind or hail loss. The dwelling payment entries carry 4000.00 of deductible, so nothing is left and the contents absorb 0.00. With contents replacement-cost value 5000.00, depreciation 1000.00 and contents money already issued 4000.00, the settled basis is 4000.00 and the supplemental is 0.00.

*Case C — the replacement-cost limit on absorption and the floor.* 500.00 of the occurrence deductible is left, but the contents replacement-cost value is only 300.00 with depreciation 60.00: the contents absorb 300.00, the settled basis works out below zero, and the supplemental is 0.00.

*Case D — the waiver.* A package waiver threshold taken as 50000.00, with denial and non-replacing payment entries on the claim together carrying 52000.00 of replacement-cost value: the contents absorb nothing and the settled basis is the replacement-cost value less the depreciation.

**Points of judgement**

- The same-event share arises only when the HomeGuard claim's cause of loss is a freeze or a sudden discharge of water, and only from LandlordGuard claims of that customer with the same date of loss and a freeze or sudden-discharge cause.
- The share never exceeds the whole occurrence deductible.
- The contents money already issued includes recoverable-depreciation payments on the personal property.
